newsitem.title: USA: US late spot prods hold sharp gains tracking NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US late spot prods hold sharp gains tracking NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot refined product prices remained sharply higher late Monday amid firmer NYMEX values and bullish sentiment over crude oil, although differentials were little changed from late last week, traders said.
U.S. Gulf Coast low sulphur diesel diffs firmed about 0.10 cent, a slight rebound from the 1.50 cent decline in diffs seen last Friday sparked by an Amoco-led selloff.
Prompt barrels were offered at 1.0 cents below May futures late day after getting done Monday for 0.95 cent under, traders said.
USG heating oil diffs were stable, with deals heard getting done at 1.35 cents under May NYMEX futures, although absolute values reached higher in tandem with a 0.80-cent rise on the May screen.
Overall, as many as 400,000 barrels of middle distillate products were said to have changed hands Monday in USG markets -- not a bad volume for a day lacking any major trends, traders said.
